items.title: Alibaba's Qwen4-Max takes on Opus 5.5, GPT-6, and Kimi K3.1 Pro at much lower prices
items.summary: Alibaba launches Qwen4-Max, a new flagship model with 2.4 trillion parameters that activates only 71 billion per token. A hybrid architecture sharply cuts costs on long contexts. Qwen4-Max lands just behind Kimi K3.1 Pro on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index, and Alibaba plans to release smaller Qwen4 models as open source. The article Alibaba's Qwen4-Max takes on Opus 5.5, GPT-6, and Kimi K3.1 Pro at much lower prices appeared first on The Decoder .

items.title: Trump to Name Nvidia, Amazon and Microsoft AI “National Champions” as Bessent Demands a Shakeup
items.summary: Key TakeawaysThe Trump administration plans to name NVIDIA, Amazon, Microsoft, OpenAI and Anthropic among more than two dozen AI “national champions,” the Wall Street Journal reported on Sunday. The same day, Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent called for a “dramatic shakeup” at NVIDIA and urged its board to hire an outside CEO.
